outcome: subdural haemorrhage (SDH) secondary to intracranial arachnoid cysts (IACs)
cohort: The study included 157 children with intracranial arachnoid cysts, comprising 144 with unruptured cysts and 13 with subdural hemorrhage secondary to cysts.
finding: Image type III of intracranial arachnoid cysts and caesarean delivery were identified as independent factors influencing subdural hemorrhage secondary to these cysts in children.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was identified as an independent factor influencing subdural hemorrhage secondary to intracranial arachnoid cysts.
